Study Design and Management

Omar Elashkar

Source: vignettes/Study_Design.Rmd
Study_Design.Rmd

In our proposed workflow, we put a lot of emphasis on the plate design and management. The plate will carry all information needed not only for bioanalytical purposes, but also the pharmacokinetic information needed for the study.

library(PKbioanalysis)

newstudy <- data.frame(
  type = "SD",
  pkstudy = TRUE,
  title = "New Study",
  description = "Description of the new study",
  subject_type = "Human"
)
new_study <- create_new_study(newstudy)
